caption: The drawing features three views of an octagonal pendant with a large, central, faceted pink-red gemstone set in a yellow-gold frame. The top left depicts a front view, showing the gemstone surrounded by the frame with visible setting details. The lower center displays a similar view but includes a gold bail at the top, suggesting how the pendant would hang. The right side shows a side view, revealing the thickness of the setting, the profile of the faceted stone, and the construction of the frame, including the support for the stone. The drawing is rendered within a lightly outlined rectangle on a cream-colored background, and the artist’s signature, "W. W. Jennings," is present in the lower right corner within the bordered area.
title: Brooch
